uso: Dado, cara 1 (bandejas, chat de revelación, apuesta actual; 24-96 px).
prompt: A single six-sided die seen almost straight from above so the TOP FACE is large and square-on, with only a hint of the two lit side faces (very slight 3/4 bevel). Die hand-carved from animal bone, off-white to yellow, slightly uneven faces and softened corners; the pips are burnt-in black (#1b130c) rough circles. Pips are VERY LARGE, bold and high-contrast so they read at 24 px. Standard pip layout. No shadow, no ground, no text, no numerals. Centered with generous margin. The top face shows exactly 1 pip (one large centered pip).

uso: Mia/Meyer: cubilete tapando los dados.
prompt: A drinking-horn dice cup with a forged iron band and a leather strap, scratched and sooty. Shown standing upside down covering the dice, 3/4 view from slightly above. No shadow, no table.

uso: Mia/Meyer: cubilete levantado al revelar.
prompt: A drinking-horn dice cup with a forged iron band and a leather strap, scratched and sooty. The same cup tilted and lifted about 35 degrees, mouth toward the viewer, dark empty interior. Identical materials, scale and style to the closed cup. No dice, no shadow, no table.

uso: Fondo de la zona de juego (dados y estado).
prompt: Seamless tileable texture. Rough dark-green wool cloth, visible coarse weave, a few wax drips and dark stains. Flat lighting so it tiles, no objects, low contrast, no vignette.

uso: Fondo de paneles de lectura: formulario de partida y mensajes de chat.
prompt: Seamless tileable texture. Dirty vellum with faint ink ruling, wine stains and darkened fibres. Completely free of text, folds that break the tile and vignette; very low contrast so text on top stays readable.

uso: Marcos, bordes y fondo de las cabeceras de ventana.
prompt: Seamless tileable texture. Scarred dark oak planks with forged nail heads. Flat lighting so it tiles, low contrast, no dominant features.

uso: Adorno de esquina de las ventanas (se gira por CSS a las 4 esquinas).
prompt: A corner ornament for a frame, TOP-LEFT orientation, arms running along the top and left edges: blackened wrought-iron corner bracket with rivets and a plain medieval spur. Arms end cleanly at the canvas edges (touching the top and left edge is allowed for THIS asset), transparent elsewhere. Matches the palette and materials of the skin.

uso: Separador horizontal entre secciones.
prompt: A thin horizontal divider, perfectly symmetric left-right: a wrought-iron rule with a single large nail head in the exact centre. Readable on both dark and light backgrounds.

uso: Barra de título de las ventanas (se estira a lo ancho).
prompt: A window title-bar strip: dark oak plank with a thin forged-iron strap along the bottom edge. The middle 80 % must be plain with NO focal features so it can stretch and tile horizontally; left and right edges must tile horizontally.

uso: Botón principal (Subir, Anunciar, Iniciar partida).
prompt: A flat button plate texture, rectangle edge to edge: dark iron plate with brass rivets at the corners and an engraved inner border. Completely empty in the centre (text goes there), no ornament in the middle, no text. Same construction, lighting and detail level as the other two button plates.

uso: Botón «¡Mentira!» / «¡Dudo!».
prompt: A flat button plate texture, rectangle edge to edge: dried-blood-red leather plate with iron rivets. Completely empty in the centre (text goes there), no ornament in the middle, no text. Same construction, lighting and detail level as the other two button plates.

uso: Botón secundario (Calzar, Acepto).
prompt: A flat button plate texture, rectangle edge to edge: tan cracked leather plate with simple stitching. Completely empty in the centre (text goes there), no ornament in the middle, no text. Same construction, lighting and detail level as the other two button plates.

uso: Contador de dados/vidas que quedan (sustituye a ★ y ♥).
prompt: A single tallow candle stub with a small steady flame, melted wax at the base. Bold simple shape, thick readable silhouette, readable at 24 px.

uso: Dado/vida perdida (se muestra apagado junto a los que quedan).
prompt: The same candle stub snuffed, a thin curl of smoke, cold grey wax. Same size, angle and style as `vida.png`.

uso: Moneda suelta (entradas, premios).
prompt: A worn crude copper coin with a rough crown relief (no text, no numerals). Bold rim, readable at 24 px.

uso: Bote de la partida.
prompt: A small leather drawstring pouch spilling a few copper coins. Bold silhouette, readable at 32 px.

uso: Fondo de escena para jugar (opcional): el GM lo pone como imagen de la escena.
prompt: Top-down heavy scarred-oak round table with a dark-green cloth centre, candle stubs, two tankards, a dagger stuck in the wood and a few copper coins near the OUTER edges only. The central 60 % of the picture is clear, calm and low-contrast so game tokens read perfectly on top. Slight dark vignette at the corners. No text, no characters.

uso: Imagen principal de la skin: ficha del módulo y selector. ¡Es la referencia de estilo!
prompt: HERO EMBLEM (still life, no characters): A bone die, a dagger and a burning candle stub on a scarred oak plank, dramatic single-candle light. Centered compact composition, rich painterly detail, no text, no background.
